entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: An identifier contained in bits 1 to 8 of the second octet (octet 1a) of every EPS Session Management (ESM) message. It is used to identify procedure transactions.

entities.name: EPS Session Management message
entities.description: A message in the EPS Session Management protocol that contains the procedure transaction identity in its second octet.

relations.description: Every ESM message contains the procedure transaction identity in bits 1-8 of its second octet.
The procedure transaction identity is defined as part of the ESM message structure.
